properties.notes: Redevelopment of the site to provide a mix of uses. Development will be expected to:• Safeguard the provision of fire station facilities or support alternative local fire service and facility provision.• Optimise the potential of the site to provide new housing while minimising potential conflicts between residential and other uses• Provide an acceptable standard of residential accommodation for any new homes proposed for the site.• Ensure that the amenity of nearby residential occupiers is maintained• Provide an appropriate level of affordable housing, in line with adopted council policies• Explore the potential to link up with existing and emerging developments to form a decentralised energy network
